kernel_of_truth: The dome correctly identifies the SAA western cell as drifting westward; the direction matches IGRF-13/CHAOS-7 observation and the dome aetheric-return-flow mechanism is the right order of magnitude (0.2-0.5 deg/yr) for what core-flow theory also predicts. The number 0.3 deg even matches the real ANNUAL westward drift rate (0.28 +/- 0.03 deg/yr, Finlay et al. 2020). The failure is purely a timescale/magnitude error: the dome committed to >=0.3 deg over a single MONTH (April->May), ~12x faster than the measured annual rate.
